location: gs:IMO116Shape sh:property nltl:notComminutedOrDisinfected and the sh:or branches
problem: The requirement makes sewageDischargeType the sole applicability condition, but the candidate additionally requires notComminutedOrDisinfected and gates the conditional obligations on its boolean value. A conforming record with sewageDischargeType equal to not_comminuted_or_disinfected and all required MARPOL and distance conditions can therefore fail merely because this redundant property is absent or false; non-target discharge types are also unnecessarily constrained to have this property false.
required_change: Remove the mandatory and branch-gating constraints on nltl:notComminutedOrDisinfected, or otherwise make all MARPOL and distance obligations depend solely on sewageDischargeType = "not_comminuted_or_disinfected".
regression_guard: Preserve the requirement that MARPOL compliance, distance greater than 12 nautical miles, and the concentration-area distance record apply exactly when sewageDischargeType equals "not_comminuted_or_disinfected".
